full_judgment: This rule has been issued calling upon the opposite party No.1 to show cause as to why the judgment and order dated 30-7-2017 passed by learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Moulvibazar in Miscellaneous Appeal No.10 of 2009 allowing the application under order 6 Rule 17 read with sections 107 and 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of the application of pre-emption of pre-emption case No.23 of 2003 by decreasing the area of the schedule land from 0.23 acres to 0.1150 acres of Khatian No.284 should not be set aside.
